note: THE VAULT INTAKE: batches of captures headed for the catalog. Paste Drive links (shared 'Anyone with the link', Viewer), push, and vault-ingest.yml pulls them on a runner, reads the EXIF, builds stamped web derivatives, runs Gemini, and files every capture as a row in Supabase. NOTHING is committed to this repo: originals stay in Drive, derivatives go to Storage, the catalog lives in the database. RAW (.ARW etc.) is welcome here, unlike the gallery intake.

batches.hint: Copy this object, give it a real id, point event at a data/gallery.json event id (or leave blank for loose captures), paste a Drive folder or file links, set done:false, push. When the run finishes, flip done:true so the next push doesn't re-scan it (dupes bounce on sha256 anyway, but skipping is faster).
